metrics.device: Median of 12 window means; each window sums all op kernel durations over 10 calls, including transforms, then divides by calls.
metrics.host: Median of 12 window medians; each unprofiled window times 30 calls including device synchronization and output allocation.
metrics.ratio: Codegen divided by native; under 1 means faster.

scope: 18 reference cases; BF16 tiled DRAM input; UINT32 tiled DRAM index; public route asserted codegen; public/native/codegen exact torch.equal against torch.gather.
